name: messenger-catchup
description: Dev tooling for the Messenger Catch-up skill (tests only; the plugin itself is the plugin/ folder)

scripts.setup: playwright install chromium && npm run hooks && npm run setup:py
scripts.fmt: prettier --write 'plugin/skills/*/assets/*.html' 'plugin/skills/*/assets/*.js' 'tests/*.js' 'tests/mock/*.html' && .venv/bin/ruff format plugin tests tools && npm run sync
scripts.test: npm run fmt:check && node tests/run.js --py && npm run test:page
